proposal.hypothesis: The serial path should avoid OpenMP team startup when threads<=1. For small effective teams (up to 4), static row assignment should keep scheduling overhead low; for larger teams such as 40, dynamic one-row chunks may better balance variation in per-ray BVH work. Rows give each pixel exactly one writer, while the ray calculation and both output writes stay unchanged. The controller must measure the tradeoff; no candidate speedup is assumed.

retained: Retain the existing serial rendering path for threads<=1 (and when the effective team is one).
Add OpenMP row parallelism with num_threads capped by both threads and image height; each worker writes its assigned rows and both output arrays.
Use static row scheduling for effective teams of up to 4 and dynamic one-row scheduling for larger teams to test the scheduling-overhead/load-balance tradeoff.
